name: ATC Pedestrian Tracking Dataset
summary: 在大阪 ATC 购物中心采集的大规模行人轨迹数据集，通过环境传感器长期跟踪真实人群移动，适合研究室内社会导航和人群流演化。
summaryEn: A large pedestrian-tracking dataset collected in Osaka's ATC shopping mall, using environmental sensors to track real crowd movement over long periods for indoor social navigation and crowd-flow evolution.
scale: Long-term pedestrian tracking data from a shopping mall environment
scaleZh: 来自购物中心环境的长期行人跟踪数据
organizations: ATR Intelligent Robotics and Communication Laboratories
organizationsZh: ATR Intelligent Robotics and Communication Laboratories
licenseZh: 数据集条款需进一步核查
access: Official ATC dataset page provides data access information
accessZh: 官方 ATC 数据集页面提供数据访问说明
verdict: 真实室内人群长期轨迹
wmNote: ATC 可用于人群流和室内社会导航建模；传感器视角和场景较固定，视觉模态有限。
wmNoteEn: ATC supports crowd-flow and indoor social-navigation modeling, but has fixed sensing geometry and limited visual modalities.
